rationale: CR-001 is resolved: bin/codemie.js now keeps runPending's result and, under --json and not in a hook, prints one 'Warning: N migration(s) failed; see the log file for details' line to stderr, leaving stdout pure JSON; a new integration test (RED then GREEN, 20/20) pins it and the happy path asserts no spurious warning. The fix-up introduces no new high-risk issue (hook stderr untouched by the !isHookProcess guard, runPending always returns an object, EPIPE already handled), so no confirmation pass was needed.

business_review.item: AC1: `codemie proxy analytics status --json` on a clean CODEMIE_HOME prints only valid JSON to stdout
business_review.notes: runPending is silent when argv has --json; update check and what's-new notice skipped; regression test asserts exit 0, no 'migration(s)' in stdout and JSON.parse(stdout). Reviewer also ran the repro manually: JSON.parse OK, empty stderr.

business_review.item: AC2: The migration banner does not appear in stdout when --json is used
business_review.notes: Every console.log in runner.ts is gated by !silent; details go to the file log ([MigrationRunner] Found ...).

business_review.item: Scope is the --json flag only; version/--version control tests keep asserting the banner
business_review.notes: Helper matches only --json and --json=...; control tests untouched and passing (19/19 in hook-stdout.test.ts).

business_review.item: Hook behaviour (hook, sound) must not change
business_review.notes: isHookProcess logic unchanged; additions are `|| isMachineOutput` / `&& !isMachineOutput` only; hook/sound tests pass.

business_review.item: A failed migration must never block the command; its warning stays on stderr, never stdout
business_review.notes: Never blocks and never reaches stdout, but under --json a failure handled inside runPending (result.success=false or throw in up()) is no longer shown anywhere except the log file: runner console.log lines are gated by silent and logger.error prints only in debug mode. Previously it appeared on stdout.

business_review.item: Conventions: ESM, .js extensions, no console.log for debug, no any, explicit return types on exports
business_review.notes: machine-output.ts exports isMachineOutputInvocation(argv: readonly string[]): boolean; imports use .js.

business_review.item: Helper wired into bin/codemie.js; migrations still run and are recorded; `--` terminator and look-alikes do not match
business_review.notes: Integration test asserts migrations.json written and log line present; unit tests cover --, --jsonl, --no-json, -j, --json-schema.

business_review.item: Regression test, helper unit test and docs/COMMANDS.md updated

standards_review.notes: Subjects use allowed type/scope (fix(cli), docs(cli)), under 100 chars; ticket in body footer.
ESM, .js extensions, no any, no console.log debug. bin/codemie.js is plain JS outside tsc/eslint (noted, not a violation).
No secrets, no attribution-header changes, no path or process handling touched.
